orders.q1: How do I place an order?
orders.a1: Browse our Shop or Collections, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll be directed to our secure Shopify-powered checkout to complete your purchase.
orders.q2: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
orders.a2: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 1 hour of placement. Please contact us via WhatsApp or email as soon as possible and we'll do our best to accommodate your request.
orders.q3: Do I need an account to order?
orders.a3: No account is required. You can check out as a guest. However, creating an account allows you to track orders and save your details for future purchases.
orders.a4: Yes. All payments are processed through Shopify's secure, PCI-compliant checkout. We never store your payment details on our servers.

shipping.a1: Standard shipping within Portugal takes 2-4 business days. International orders typically arrive within 5-10 business days depending on destination.
shipping.a2: Yes! Orders over €50 qualify for free standard shipping within Portugal. International shipping rates are calculated at checkout.
shipping.a3: Absolutely. Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number by email so you can follow your delivery in real time.
shipping.a4: Yes, we ship to most European countries and beyond. Shipping costs and estimated delivery times are shown at checkout based on your location.

returns.a1: We accept returns on unopened, unused products within 14 days of delivery. Items must be in their original packaging. Contact us first to initiate a return.
returns.q2: How do I return a product?
returns.a2: Contact us via email or WhatsApp with your order number and reason for return. We'll guide you through the process and provide a return shipping label where applicable.
returns.q3: When will I receive my refund?
returns.a3: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item. The amount will be returned to your original payment method.
returns.q4: What if I received a damaged or wrong item?
returns.a4: We're sorry to hear that! Please contact us immediately with a photo of the item and your order number. We'll arrange a replacement or full refund at no extra cost to you.

products.a1: Yes. Every product in our store is professional grade, hand-selected by our team of expert stylists who use them daily in the salon.
products.q2: Are the products suitable for all hair types?
products.a2: Our collection includes products for all hair types — fine, thick, curly, straight, colour-treated, and more. Each product page includes guidance on which hair types it suits best.
products.a3: We prioritise brands that are cruelty-free and where possible, sustainably sourced. Product pages indicate certifications relevant to each item.
products.q4: How do I know which product is right for me?
products.a4: Check the product description for hair type guidance, or contact us via WhatsApp — our stylists are happy to give a personal recommendation based on your hair needs.
